dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Have you decided on what to eat?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Fine. I'll go ahead and order then.

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: So, when you do the thing where you pretend not to hear a question if you don't want to answer, it works like a charm. But, not when I do it?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: That's because you have to use it on the right person.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Besides, you really think you can use my own tricks against me?
